broad: long-distance propagation of posttranscriptional gene silencing

definition: An siRNA-mediated posttranscriptional gene silencing pathway in which small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) direct the cleavage of target mRNAs, and in which the silencing signal originates in one tissue and occurs in a different tissue.
label: siRNA-mediated long-distance post-transcriptional gene silencing
